provenance.paper_title: DigimonGPT: An Evolvable Agent with Hierarchical Human-like Memory for Video Question Answering

evidence.paraphrase: Video features and semantic contexts are retained in hierarchical declarative memory.
Task-solving experiences are encoded as reusable procedural records and replayed by relevance and complexity.

Historical question-answering episodes are abstracted into procedural experience. For DigimonGPT, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of intra-video declarative memory.
Hierarchical replay consolidates experience at multiple levels. For DigimonGPT, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of intra-video declarative memory.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (intra-video declarative memory) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
